This is the convention following Conjecture 5.1 of Castillejos–Evington–Tikuisis–White. No UCT, unitality, finite trace-boundary, uniform Gamma or finite nuclear dimension hypothesis is added.

records.title: Shelah's Categoricity Conjecture for L_omega1,omega
records.exactTarget: Prove or refute the strong categoricity transfer for L_omega1,omega: if an L_omega1,omega sentence is categorical in some cardinal at least the Hanf threshold delta_omega1, then it is categorical in every cardinal at least that threshold.

records.title: Existence of a Finitely Presented Group of Intermediate Growth
records.exactTarget: There exists a finitely presented group G with a finite generating set S whose word-ball growth gamma(n) is subexponential, meaning lim(n->infinity) log(gamma(n))/n=0, but is not bounded by any polynomial in n.

records.title: Pólya's Conjecture for Dirichlet Eigenvalues
records.exactTarget: For every bounded open domain Ω⊂R^d of finite volume, d≥2, prove that every Dirichlet-Laplacian eigenvalue satisfies λ_k(Ω)≥(2π)^2(k/(ω_d|Ω|))^{2/d} for all k≥1, where ω_d is the volume of the unit d-ball.

records.title: Shelah's Conjecture on NIP Fields
records.exactTarget: Prove that every infinite field whose first-order theory (in the language of rings) has the independence property negated (is NIP, or dependent) is either separably closed, real closed, or admits a non-trivial henselian valuation; Johnson proved the conjecture for fields of finite dp-rank, and the general NIP case is open.

records.title: The Cherlin-Zilber Algebraicity Conjecture for Simple Groups of Finite Morley Rank
records.exactTarget: Prove that every infinite simple group of finite Morley rank is isomorphic to the group of rational points of a linear algebraic group over an algebraically closed field.

records.title: Lieb-Thirring Conjecture on the Sharp Constant for Riesz Means of Order One in Three Dimensions
records.exactTarget: Prove that the optimal constant L_{1,3} in Tr(-Delta+V)_- <= L_{1,3} integral_{R^3} V_-(x)^(5/2) dx equals the semiclassical constant L_{1,3}^{cl}=1/(15*pi^2).

records.title: Arnold-Givental Lagrangian intersection conjecture
records.exactTarget: For a compact real symplectic manifold (M, omega, tau) with compact nonempty real part L = Fix(tau), and for every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism phi such that L and phi(L) meet transversely, prove that the number of intersection points is at least the total Z/2 Betti number of L.

records.title: Igusa’s Standard p-Adic Monodromy Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every n≥1 and nonconstant f∈Q[x_1,...,x_n], there is a finite set S_f of primes such that for every p outside S_f, every complex-valued locally constant compactly supported function phi on Q_p^n, and every actual pole s_0 of the meromorphic continuation of Z_p(f,phi;s)=integral |f(x)|_p^s phi(x) dx, exp(2*pi*i*Re(s_0)) is an eigenvalue of the local complex monodromy of f at some point of {f=0}⊂C^n. Haar measure is normalized by vol(Z_p^n)=1; the nonzero normalization does not affect poles. This is the standard assertion of Veys Conjecture 2.12(1); S_f depends on f, not on phi. Strong Bernstein–Sato, origin-only, differential-form, topological, motivic and character variants are not silently identified with it.

records.title: LeBrun-Salamon Conjecture: positive quaternion-Kahler manifolds are symmetric spaces
records.exactTarget: Prove that every compact quaternion-Kahler manifold with positive scalar curvature and holonomy contained in Sp(n)Sp(1) is a symmetric space.

records.title: Pugh–Shub Stable Ergodicity (C^r Density in Partial Hyperbolicity)
records.exactTarget: For every compact connected boundaryless smooth manifold M with a smooth probability volume m, and every r in [2,infinity] (including the C^infinity topology), is the following true? In the space PH_m^r(M) of volume-preserving C^r partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms, maps that are C^1-stably ergodic among C^2 volume-preserving diffeomorphisms are C^r-dense. Thus every f in PH_m^r(M) and every relative C^r neighborhood U of f contain g such that some C^1 neighborhood V of g has every C^2 volume-preserving h in V ergodic for m. Use the usual C^r topology, with the Holder convention for nonintegral finite r. Partial hyperbolicity means a continuous Df-invariant dominated splitting TM=E^u+E^c+E^s: E^u and E^s are nontrivial, E^c may be zero, and for some common integer N>=1 the unstable unit vectors expand by >2, stable unit vectors contract by <1/2, and earlier nonzero bundles dominate later ones by a factor >2 under Df^N, pointwise at the same base point in that order. This is the ACW stability convention with the r>=2 range documented by RHRHU, not density among all conservative diffeomorphisms or only C^1-density.

records.title: Partition Regularity of Pythagorean Triples
records.witness: for fixed r, a colouring of [1,N] is a finite SAT instance
records.exactTarget: Determine whether every finite coloring of the positive integers contains positive integers x, y, and z of one color satisfying x^2 + y^2 = z^2.

records.title: NP-Hardness of Constant-Factor Approximation for Densest k-Subgraph
records.exactTarget: Let OPT(G,k)=max_{S subseteq V(G), |S|=k}|E(G[S])| for a finite simple undirected input graph G. Prove or refute the assertion that there exists an absolute constant epsilon>0 for which the promise problem of distinguishing OPT(G,k)>=t from OPT(G,k)<t/(1+epsilon), with input integers 1<=k<=|V(G)| and t>=1, is NP-hard under deterministic polynomial-time gap reductions. The target is any fixed nontrivial constant approximation gap for exactly k vertices, based on NP-hardness rather than a stronger average-case or exponential-time assumption.

records.title: Separable Quotient Problem for Banach Spaces
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a quotient by a closed subspace that is both infinite-dimensional and separable.

records.title: Coding Theory and Combinatorics Problem CC-6: Existence of Finite Projective Planes of Non-Prime-Power Orders
records.witness: an incidence structure of order 12; finite check
records.exactTarget: Does there exist any finite projective plane of order 12, or of any other composite non-prime-power order not ruled out by the Bruck-Ryser-Chowla theorem?

records.title: Bourgain's unbounded Sobolev orbit problem for cubic defocusing NLS on the square two-torus
records.exactTarget: For the defocusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation i partial_t u + Delta u = |u|^2 u on the standard square torus T^2=(R/2pi Z)^2, does there exist one global smooth complex-valued solution u and a real s>1 such that limsup_{t->+infinity} ||u(t)||_{H^s(T^2)} = infinity?

records.title: Brauer-Manin obstruction to the Hasse principle for K3 surfaces
records.exactTarget: For every number field k and every K3 surface X over k (smooth projective geometrically integral surface with trivial canonical bundle and H^1(X, O_X) = 0), prove that X(A_k)^{Br(X)} nonempty implies X(k) nonempty. Here Br(X) = H^2_et(X, G_m), and X(A_k)^{Br(X)} is the set of adelic points (x_v) such that for every alpha in Br(X) the sum over all places v of inv_v(alpha(x_v)) vanishes in Q/Z, i.e. simultaneous orthogonality of one adelic point to the entire Brauer group. No assertion about weak approximation, about density of X(k) in X(A_k)^{Br(X)}, or about the existence of a single obstructing class is included.

records.title: Green's conjecture on syzygies of canonical curves
records.exactTarget: For every smooth non-hyperelliptic projective curve C, prove Green's canonical syzygy conjecture: the vanishing pattern of K_{p,1}(C,K_C) is determined by the Clifford index of C, equivalently K_{l,1}(C,K_C)=0 for all l>=p if and only if Cliff(C)>g-p-2.

records.title: Finiteness of central configurations for the n-body problem, n >= 4
records.exactTarget: For the n-body problem, n >= 4, show that the number of central configurations is finite for all choices of masses m_i > 0, or find a counterexample.

records.title: Hyperkähler SYZ (Lagrangian Fibration) Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic complex manifold X and every nontrivial nef holomorphic line bundle L with q(c1(L))=0 for the Beauville–Bogomolov–Fujiki form, some positive tensor power of L is generated by global sections.

records.title: Martin's Conjecture for Definable Turing-Invariant Functions
records.exactTarget: Under the Axiom of Determinacy, classify Turing-invariant functions on a cone by proving that each is constant or increasing and that the increasing functions are ordered by iterates of the Turing jump, or refute one of these conclusions.

records.title: Freyd's Generating Hypothesis
records.exactTarget: Prove that if f:X→Y is a map of finite spectra inducing the zero homomorphism on every stable homotopy group, then f is null-homotopic; equivalently, the natural map [X,Y]→Hom_{π_*S}(π_*X,π_*Y) is injective for all finite spectra X and Y.

records.title: Combinatorial Invariance of Kazhdan-Lusztig Polynomials
records.witness: two Bruhat intervals; KL polynomials are computable
records.exactTarget: For Coxeter systems (W_1,S_1) and (W_2,S_2), prove that any directed-graph isomorphism between Bruhat intervals [u,v] in W_1 and [w,z] in W_2 implies equality of the Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials P_{u,v}(q)=P_{w,z}(q), or construct a counterexample.

records.title: Rokhlin problem on multiple mixing
records.exactTarget: Determine whether every mixing measure-preserving transformation of a probability space is mixing of all orders: for a measure-preserving transformation T on a probability space, does mixing (that is, mu(A intersect T^{-n}B) -> mu(A)mu(B) as |n| -> infinity for all measurable A,B) imply k-fold mixing for every k >= 3, where k-fold mixing requires the correlation mu(A_1 intersect T^{-n_1}A_2 intersect ... intersect T^{-(n_1+...+n_{k-1})}A_k) to converge to the product of the measures as the gaps n_i -> infinity?

records.title: Frankl Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that in every finite union-closed family of sets other than the empty set, there exists an element that belongs to at least half of the members of the family.

records.title: Strong Hyperplane Conjecture for Isotropic Constants
records.exactTarget: For every integer n>=1 and every compact convex body K in R^n with nonempty interior, let X be uniformly distributed on K, let Cov(X) be its centered covariance matrix, and define L_K=(det(Cov(X))/Vol_n(K)^2)^(1/(2n)). Then L_K <= L_Delta_n, where Delta_n is any nondegenerate n-simplex and L_Delta_n=(n!)^(1/n)/((n+1)^((n+1)/(2n))*sqrt(n+2)). Bodies need not be centrally symmetric or smooth. The assertion asks for this sharp bound in each dimension, not uniqueness of equality or merely a dimension-free bound.

records.title: Sums of Three Cubes Representation Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every integer k not congruent to 4 or 5 modulo 9 admits a representation k = x^3 + y^3 + z^3 in integers, with Heath-Brown's refinement asking for infinitely many such representations for each eligible k.

records.title: Yau's First Eigenvalue Conjecture for Minimal Hypersurfaces
records.exactTarget: Prove that every connected closed embedded minimal hypersurface M^n in the unit sphere S^(n+1) has first nonzero Laplace-Beltrami eigenvalue equal to n.

records.title: Long-Time Existence of the Calabi Flow on Compact Kaehler Manifolds
records.exactTarget: For a compact Kaehler manifold in a Kaehler class containing a constant-scalar-curvature Kaehler metric, prove that the Calabi flow from every smooth initial Kaehler metric in the class exists for all time and converges smoothly to a cscK metric.

records.title: Nirenberg Problem on the Two-Sphere
records.exactTarget: Characterize the smooth functions K on the unit two-sphere that occur as the Gaussian curvature of a metric conformal to the standard round metric.

records.title: Margulis–Platonov normal-subgroup conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every absolutely almost simple simply connected algebraic group G over a number field K, let A be the finite set of nonarchimedean places v with rank over K_v of G equal to zero, and let delta:G(K)→∏_{v∈A}G(K_v) be the diagonal map. Every noncentral normal subgroup N of G(K) is delta^−1(W) for some open normal subgroup W of that product, with the empty product interpreted as the trivial group.

records.title: Smallest number of variables for undecidable Hilbert's Tenth Problem over Z
records.exactTarget: Determine the least integer n for which no algorithm decides whether an arbitrary integer-coefficient polynomial in at most n variables has an integer zero.

records.title: Polynomial-Time P-Matrix Linear Complementarity Problem
records.witness: the P-matrix linear complementarity problem
records.exactTarget: Determine whether the unique solution of every linear complementarity problem with a rational P-matrix and rational right-hand side can be computed in time polynomial in the bit length of the input.

records.title: Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove or refute the Friedgut-Kalai conjecture that there exists a universal constant C such that for every Boolean function f: {-1,1}^n -> {-1,1}, the spectral entropy of f (the Shannon entropy of the distribution given by its squared Fourier coefficients) is at most C times its total influence I(f).

records.title: Zarankiewicz Problem on K_{t,t}-Free Bipartite Graphs
records.exactTarget: Determine the asymptotic order of magnitude of ex(n, K_{t,t}), the maximum number of edges in an n-vertex bipartite graph containing no K_{t,t}, for each fixed t >= 2.

records.title: Capacity of the General Discrete Memoryless Relay Channel
records.exactTarget: Find a computable exact average-error Shannon-capacity characterization for every finite-alphabet discrete memoryless relay channel with law p(y,y_r|x,x_r) and a relay whose input at each time is a causal function of its past observations.

records.title: Greenberg's Conjecture on Vanishing of Iwasawa Invariants of Totally Real Fields
records.exactTarget: Prove that for every totally real number field F and every prime p, the Iwasawa invariants lambda_p(F) and mu_p(F) of the cyclotomic Z_p-extension vanish; equivalently, the p-parts of class numbers in the tower remain bounded.

records.title: Coleman-Oort conjecture: eventual special-subvariety exclusion
records.exactTarget: There exists an integer g0 such that for every integer g>=g0 the complex Siegel moduli space A_g of principally polarized abelian varieties contains no positive-dimensional irreducible special (Shimura) subvariety S generically contained in the smooth-Jacobian Torelli locus T_g^o. Precisely, if T_g is the Zariski closure of the image of the moduli of smooth genus-g complex curves under the Torelli map, the prohibited S satisfies S subset T_g and S intersection T_g^o nonempty, hence open dense in S. No fixed, optimal or effective threshold is prescribed. The statement excludes neither isolated CM points nor special subvarieties wholly in the decomposable boundary.

records.title: Exact Consistency Strength of the Proper Forcing Axiom (PFA)
records.exactTarget: Determine the exact large-cardinal consistency strength of the Proper Forcing Axiom.

records.title: Bartnik Quasi-Local Mass and Static Vacuum Extension Problem
records.exactTarget: Determine the valid scope of Bartnik's quasi-local mass conjectures: characterize boundary data for which an asymptotically flat static vacuum extension exists and realizes the Bartnik quasi-local mass, after counterexamples to the unrestricted static extension conjecture.

records.title: Colmezs Conjecture on Faltings Heights of CM Abelian Varieties
records.exactTarget: Prove for every CM abelian variety that its stable Faltings height is the Colmez linear combination of logarithmic derivatives at s=0 of the Artin L-functions determined by its CM type.

records.title: Gromov-Lawson-Rosenberg Conjecture for Finite Fundamental Groups
records.exactTarget: For every finite group G and every closed connected smooth spin manifold M of dimension n>=5 with pi_1(M)=G, prove or disprove that M admits a positive-scalar-curvature metric if and only if its real Rosenberg index alpha(M) in KO_n(C*_r(G;R)) vanishes.

records.title: GNRS Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every nontrivial minor-closed family of finite undirected graphs has uniformly bounded multi-commodity flow-cut gap, equivalently uniformly bounded L1 distortion for its shortest-path metrics, with the constant depending only on the excluded minor family.

records.title: Irrationality of Catalan's Constant
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that Catalan's constant G = beta(2) = sum over n >= 0 of (-1)^n / (2n+1)^2 = 0.9159655941... is an irrational number.

records.title: Zariski Cancellation Problem (characteristic zero, dimension ≥ 3)
records.exactTarget: For every characteristic-zero field k and n >= 3, prove or disprove that B[X] isomorphic to k[X_1,...,X_{n+1}] implies B isomorphic to k[X_1,...,X_n] for affine k-algebras B.

records.title: Absolute continuity of Bernoulli convolutions outside reciprocal Pisot parameters
records.exactTarget: For every lambda in (1/2,1) whose reciprocal is not a Pisot number, is the law nu_lambda of the random series sum_{n>=0} epsilon_n lambda^n, with independent signs epsilon_n equally likely +1 or -1, absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure?

records.title: Measure-zero singular set of stationary integral varifolds
records.exactTarget: For all positive integers m and n, every stationary integral m-varifold V in an open subset U of Euclidean R^{m+n} has H^m(Sing(V))=0, where Sing(V) is the complement in spt(V) intersect U of the points having a neighborhood on which V is an integer multiple of a smooth embedded minimal m-submanifold.

records.title: Maximal Number of Mutually Unbiased Bases in Composite Dimensions
records.witness: 7 MUBs in D=6 would be an explicit finite set of bases
records.exactTarget: Determine the maximal number K of mutually unbiased bases in a D-dimensional Hilbert space for non-prime-power composite dimensions D (in particular, decide whether K = 7 MUBs exist in dimension D = 6).

records.title: Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every group is surjunctive; equivalently, for every group G and every finite alphabet A, every injective cellular automaton A^G -> A^G is surjective.

records.title: Exact value of the site-percolation threshold on the square lattice
records.exactTarget: Determine the exact critical probability p_c for Bernoulli site percolation on the nearest-neighbor square lattice Z^2. The corresponding bond-percolation threshold is p_c = 1/2, whereas the site threshold is known only numerically, p_c approximately 0.592746, and no exact value is known.

records.title: Lovász Conjecture on Hamiltonian Paths in Vertex-Transitive Graphs
records.witness: one vertex-transitive graph with no Hamiltonian path
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every finite connected vertex-transitive graph contains a Hamiltonian path.

records.title: Uniform epsilon-equilibrium in finite multiplayer stochastic games
records.exactTarget: For every finite stochastic game with bounded stage payoffs, every epsilon>0, and every initial state s_0, prove that there are a behavioral-strategy profile sigma and N such that for every horizon n>=N no player can improve that player's expected n-stage average payoff by more than epsilon through any unilateral behavioral deviation.

records.title: Uniqueness of Tangent Cones for Area-Minimizing Integral Currents in Higher Codimension
records.exactTarget: Let T be an m-dimensional area-minimizing integral current in R^(m+n), with m>=3 and n>=2. Prove that at every interior point p all weak limits, as r decreases to 0, of the rescaled currents induced by x -> (x-p)/r coincide.

records.title: Leray's Problem for Stationary Navier-Stokes under the Total-Flux Condition in Three Dimensions
records.exactTarget: Let Omega be a bounded multiply connected domain in R^3 and let a be boundary data satisfying the total-flux compatibility condition integral_{partial Omega} a dot n = 0. Determine whether the stationary incompressible Navier-Stokes system in Omega has a weak solution without requiring zero flux on each connected boundary component or imposing symmetry.

records.title: Deterministic Linear-Time Minimum Spanning Tree Problem
records.exactTarget: Determine whether there exists a uniform deterministic comparison-based algorithm that, for every connected undirected graph with n vertices and m edges carrying distinct real-valued weights, computes a minimum spanning tree in worst-case O(m) time on a pointer machine, with edge weights accessed only by binary comparisons, in the model of Pettie and Ramachandran (2002).

records.title: Computability of the Shannon Capacity of Finite Graphs
records.witness: computability of the Shannon capacity of finite graphs
records.exactTarget: Determine whether an algorithm exists which, given the exact adjacency matrix of any nonempty finite simple graph G and an integer t>=1, halts and returns a rational a with |a-Theta(G)|<=2^(-t), where Theta(G)=sup_{m>=1} alpha(G^{boxtimes m})^(1/m), alpha is independence number and boxtimes is the strong graph product. No running-time bound is imposed.

records.title: Katok entropy rigidity conjecture
records.exactTarget: For a closed negatively curved Riemannian manifold, the Liouville entropy of the geodesic flow equals its topological entropy if and only if the metric is locally symmetric.

records.title: Stein's Conjecture on the Hilbert Transform along Lipschitz Vector Fields
records.exactTarget: For every Lipschitz unit vector field v:R^2->S^1, prove that there exists epsilon>0, depending only at the natural scale on the Lipschitz norm of v, such that H_{v,epsilon}f(x)=p.v. integral from -epsilon to epsilon of f(x-yv(x)) dy/y defines a bounded operator on L^2(R^2).

records.title: Brown-Erdos-Sos Conjecture on Sparse Triple Systems
records.exactTarget: For every fixed integer k>=3 and every epsilon>0, does there exist N=N(k,epsilon) such that every 3-uniform hypergraph on n>=N vertices with at least epsilon n^2 edges contains k distinct edges whose union has at most k+3 vertices? Equivalently, for each fixed k, the maximum size of an n-vertex 3-graph avoiding such a configuration is o(n^2). The target is the full (k+3,k) conjecture, not the separate (k+2,k) asymptotic-constant problem.

records.title: Matroid Secretary Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Determine whether there exist an absolute constant c>0 and an online algorithm A such that, for every finite known matroid M=(E,I) and every adversarially fixed nonnegative weight function w, A receives the elements in uniformly random order, learns an element's weight only when it arrives, makes irrevocable acceptance decisions, always maintains an independent accepted set ALG, and satisfies E[w(ALG)] >= c max_{S in I} w(S). The expectation is over the arrival order and any internal randomness of A; A may use the known matroid but not unseen weights.

records.title: Kaplansky's Direct Finiteness Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that for every group G, every field K, and all a,b in the group ring K[G], the equation ab=1 implies ba=1; equivalently, every group ring over a field is directly finite (and, by the known equivalence, stably finite).

records.title: Minkowski's conjecture on products of non-homogeneous linear forms
records.exactTarget: For every dimension n>=1, every real nonsingular n by n matrix A with |det A|=1 and every translation x in R^n, there exists an integer vector m in Z^n such that the product over i=1,...,n of |x_i+(Am)_i| is at most 2^(-n). The quantifier requires an ACTUAL integer witness at the closed bound, not merely an infimum no greater than the bound. Equivalently, scaling a general real nonsingular matrix B and its translation by |det B|^(-1/n) gives the same actual-witness assertion with bound |det B|/2^n; all coefficients and translations are real. No equality characterization of extremal lattices, well-rounded Euclidean covering assertion, positive-characteristic analogue or constructive algorithm is appended. Preserve all dimensions, not merely a selected high-dimensional open remainder.

records.title: Witsenhausen Counterexample: Optimal Strategy and Cost
records.exactTarget: Determine the optimal control strategies and exact minimum expected cost for the two-stage Witsenhausen problem x1 = x0 + u1, x2 = x1 + u2, where x0 ~ N(0, sigma^2), decision maker 1 observes x0 and incurs k u1^2, and decision maker 2 observes z2 = x1 + v with v ~ N(0,1) and incurs x2^2.

records.title: Lebesgue measure of the boundary of the Mandelbrot set
records.exactTarget: Let M={c in C: the forward orbit of 0 under z maps to z2+c is bounded}. Does its boundary have two-dimensional Lebesgue measure zero, or positive two-dimensional Lebesgue measure?

records.title: Uniqueness of the KPZ Fixed Point Among Scaling-Covariant Local Fields
records.exactTarget: Prove that the KPZ fixed point is the unique non-trivial space-time field satisfying the locality condition and the specified scaling-covariance properties.

records.title: Small Cohen-Macaulay Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every complete Noetherian local ring R admits a nonzero finitely generated R-module on which a system of parameters of R is a regular sequence, equivalently a small maximal Cohen-Macaulay module.

records.title: Greek-Letter Redshift Conjecture in Algebraic K-Theory
records.exactTarget: Prove that if a commutative ring spectrum R detects the n-th Greek-letter family in the stable homotopy groups of spheres, then its algebraic K-theory K(R) detects the (n+1)-st Greek-letter family.

records.title: Von Neumann's Problem for II_1 Factors
records.exactTarget: Determine whether every nonamenable II_1 factor contains a von Neumann subalgebra isomorphic to the free group factor L(F_2), or construct a nonamenable II_1 factor with no such subfactor.

records.title: Ergodicity of Irrational Triangular Billiards
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every triangular billiard whose angles are irrational is ergodic for billiard flow.

records.title: Hall's Conjecture on Gaps Between Squares and Cubes
records.exactTarget: For every epsilon > 0, prove that there is c(epsilon) > 0 such that all positive integers x and y with y^2 != x^3 satisfy |y^2-x^3| > c(epsilon) x^(1/2-epsilon).

records.title: Capacity Region of General 3-Receiver Discrete Memoryless Broadcast Channels
records.exactTarget: Find a computable single-letter characterization of the capacity region for general 3-receiver discrete memoryless broadcast channels without degradedness assumptions.

records.title: Exact critical exponents of oriented percolation in 1+1 dimensions
records.exactTarget: For nearest-neighbor oriented percolation in 1+1 space-time dimensions at criticality, determine the exact values of rho, eta, and nu governing survival probability, the expected number of vertices connected from the origin at time t, and the gyration radius, respectively.

records.title: Balanced L4 boundedness of the trilinear Hilbert transform
records.exactTarget: For Schwartz functions f,g,h:R->C, let T(f,g,h)(x)=p.v. integral_R f(x+t)g(x+2t)h(x+3t) dt/t. Is there a finite constant C such that ||T(f,g,h)||_{L^(4/3)(R)} <= C ||f||_{L^4(R)}||g||_{L^4(R)}||h||_{L^4(R)} for every such triple?

records.title: Combinatorial Boolean Matrix Multiplication in Near-Linear Time
records.exactTarget: Determine whether there exists a purely combinatorial algorithm for boolean matrix multiplication running in time O(n^{2+o(1)}) without using algebraic Strassen-like tensor methods.

records.title: Fujita Very Ampleness Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every smooth complex projective variety X of dimension n and every ample divisor L, prove that K_X + (n+2)L is very ample.

records.title: Hadwiger-Boltyanski Illumination Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every convex body K in n-dimensional Euclidean space can be illuminated by at most 2^n external point sources or parallel beams of light.

records.title: Köthe Conjecture on Nil One-Sided Ideals
records.exactTarget: Prove or refute that a ring with no nonzero nil two-sided ideal has no nonzero nil one-sided ideal. Equivalent formulations include: the sum of two nil right ideals in any ring is nil; and for every nil ring R, the 2x2 matrix ring over R is nil.

records.title: Andrews-Curtis conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every balanced finite presentation of the trivial group can be transformed into the standard trivial presentation by Nielsen transformations of relators together with conjugations of individual relators.

records.title: Campana-Peternell Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every smooth complex projective Fano variety whose tangent bundle is nef is a rational homogeneous variety.

records.title: Erdős Matching Conjecture
records.witness: one k-uniform family F exceeding the stated bound
records.exactTarget: For all positive integers k,s,n with n>=ks, let F be a family of distinct k-element subsets of [n]={1,...,n} containing no s pairwise disjoint members. The conjecture asserts |F|<=max{binom(ks-1,k), binom(n,k)-binom(n-s+1,k)}. Here binom(a,k)=0 for integers 0<=a<k. For s=1 the family is empty, and k=1 is included as a trivial case. The two terms are attained by all k-subsets of a fixed (ks-1)-set and by all k-subsets meeting a fixed (s-1)-set, respectively. Their role is sharpness of the bound, not an additional classification of all equality families.

records.title: Zilber's Exponential-Algebraic Closedness Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every positive integer n and irreducible complex algebraic subvariety V of C^n x (C*)^n which is free and rotund, decide whether V contains (z,exp(z)) for some z in C^n. Free means that neither projection is contained in a translate of a proper Q-defined linear subspace or a proper algebraic subtorus, respectively. Rotund means dim(pi_L(V)) >= n-dim(L) for every Q-defined complex linear subspace L of C^n, where pi_L is the quotient to C^n/L x (C*)^n/exp(L). This is ordinary exponential-algebraic closedness, without an extra generic-transcendence-degree requirement.

records.title: Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove or refute: for every degree-d polynomial f: {-1,1}^n -> [0,1], there exists a coordinate j whose influence satisfies Inf_j[f] >= poly(1/d, Var[f]).

records.title: Chen-Yang Volume Conjecture for Turaev-Viro Invariants
records.exactTarget: For every finite-volume hyperbolic three-manifold M in the scope of Chen-Yang Conjecture 1.1—closed, cusped, or with totally geodesic boundary—prove or disprove that lim_{r -> infinity, r odd} (2*pi/r)*log(TV_r(M;exp(2*pi*i/r))) = Vol(M). TV is the scalar Turaev-Viro state-sum invariant in their convention, using the specified extension for nonempty boundary and a compact core for cusps. The different standard root exp(pi*i/r), and the separate complex-valued Reshetikhin-Turaev/Chern-Simons refinement, are not part of this target.

records.title: Maximum Number of k-sets and Complexity of k-levels
records.exactTarget: What is the maximum number of k-sets of an n-point set in the plane (or equivalently, the maximum complexity of a k-level in an arrangement of n lines or hyperplanes)?

records.title: Hilbert's Tenth Problem over C(t) with named t
records.witness: Hilbert's Tenth over C(t)
records.exactTarget: Let t be a fixed transcendental indeterminate and C(t) the field of complex rational functions. Determine whether there exists an algorithm (Turing machine) which, given any n >= 1 and any polynomial f in Z[t][x_1,...,x_n], presented by its finite list of integer coefficients and monomial exponents in t and the x_i, halts and correctly decides whether f = 0 has a solution (x_1,...,x_n) in C(t)^n. Equivalently, determine whether the existential (positive existential) theory of the structure (C(t); 0, 1, +, -, *, t), with a constant symbol naming t and no constants for other complex numbers, is decidable. Inputs with arbitrary complex coefficients, and the ring language without a symbol for t, are not part of this target.

records.title: Shub entropy conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every C1 self-map f of a compact smooth manifold M, prove that the topological entropy h(f) is at least the logarithm of the spectral radius of the induced map on total real homology.

records.title: Polynomial-Time Solvability of Condon's Simple Stochastic Games
records.witness: Condon's simple stochastic games
records.exactTarget: Determine whether Condon's simple stochastic games can be solved in polynomial time: given a two-player zero-sum turn-based stochastic game with binary decisions, rational transition probabilities, and a reachability objective, compute the game value, equivalently deciding whether the start-vertex value reaches a given rational threshold.

records.title: Auslander Conjecture on Affine Crystallographic Groups
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every affine crystallographic group is virtually solvable, equivalently that the fundamental group of every compact complete affine manifold is virtually polycyclic.

records.title: Koblitz Conjecture for Prime Orders of Elliptic Curves
records.exactTarget: For every non-CM elliptic curve E over Q with corrected Koblitz constant C_E>0, prove that #{p≤x: p is of good reduction and #E(F_p) is prime} is asymptotic to C_E x/(log x)^2.

records.title: Lück's Determinant Conjecture for Discrete Groups
records.exactTarget: For every discrete group G, n≥1 and A∈M_n(Z[G]), let μ be the spectral measure of A* A for the canonical group trace tensored with normalized matrix trace. Determine whether ∫_(0,∞) log(t) dμ(t)≥0 always holds, with the atom at zero omitted and a priori value −∞ allowed.

records.title: Spectral Determination of Convex Planar Domains
records.exactTarget: Determine whether two bounded convex planar domains with identical Dirichlet-Laplacian spectra must be congruent.

records.title: Deligne–Drinfeld Freeness Conjecture for grt_1
records.exactTarget: Is the weight-graded Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra grt_1 over Q freely generated by one homogeneous generator sigma_(2k+1) in each odd weight 2k+1≥3, equivalently is the known free motivic Lie subalgebra Q-Lie(sigma_3,sigma_5,...) all of grt_1 in every weight? For the completed convention, require the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion.

records.title: Li-Li Undirected Multiple-Unicast Network Coding Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every finite undirected edge-capacitated network and every finite collection of independent source-destination unicast sessions, prove or disprove that the zero-error network-coding capacity region equals the fractional multicommodity-routing capacity region. Each undirected edge has a shared capacity bounding the sum of transmission rates in its two directions; intermediate nodes may causally encode received messages in the coding model. Fractional routing may split each session over paths. The target uses the standard zero-error formulation, not multicast or directed networks.

records.title: The McKay-Navarro Conjecture for Finite Groups
records.witness: one finite group; character table and Galois action are computable
records.exactTarget: Prove the McKay-Navarro (Galois-McKay) conjecture: for a finite group G, a prime p and a Sylow p-subgroup P of G, the p'-degree irreducible characters of G and of N_G(P) can be counted compatibly with the action of Galois automorphisms on character values, generalizing the McKay conjecture blockwise for odd primes.

records.title: Existence of the Diagonal Ramsey Growth Constant
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that the limit lim_{k->infinity} R(k,k)^(1/k) exists.

records.title: Quillen's Conjecture on Posets of Elementary Abelian p-Subgroups
records.witness: a finite group -- but contractibility of the order complex is not
records.exactTarget: Prove that for every finite group G and prime p, if the order complex of the poset A_p(G) of nontrivial elementary abelian p-subgroups is contractible, then G has a nontrivial normal p-subgroup, i.e. O_p(G) != 1.

records.title: Deterministic polynomial-time factorization of dense polynomials in F_q[x]
records.exactTarget: Construct a deterministic algorithm that, given a densely represented polynomial f in F_q[x] of degree n, outputs its factorization over F_q in time polynomial in n and log(q), or prove that no such algorithm exists in the stated computational model.

records.title: David–Semmes Riesz-transform problem in intermediate dimensions
records.exactTarget: For every pair of integers 2<=n<=d-2 and every n-Ahlfors–David regular Radon measure mu on R^d, does uniform L^2(mu) boundedness over epsilon>0 of R_{mu,epsilon}f(x)=integral_{|x-y|>epsilon}(x-y)|x-y|^(-n-1)f(y)dmu(y) imply that mu is uniformly n-rectifiable?

records.title: Smooth Realization of Finite-Entropy Ergodic Transformations
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every invertible ergodic measure-preserving transformation of a standard nonatomic probability space with finite Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy is measurably isomorphic to a C-infinity diffeomorphism of some compact finite-dimensional smooth manifold preserving a smooth probability volume form.

records.title: Zariski-Lipman Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every complex algebraic variety or complex space whose tangent sheaf is locally free is smooth.

records.title: Ruzsa-Szemerédi (6,3)-Problem on Triple Systems
records.exactTarget: Determine the asymptotic order of f(n,6,3), the largest number of edges in a 3-uniform hypergraph on n vertices in which no six vertices span three or more edges.

records.title: Chern Conjecture on the Euler Characteristic of Closed Affine Manifolds
records.exactTarget: Prove that every closed affine manifold, equivalently every compact boundaryless manifold whose tangent bundle admits a flat torsion-free connection, has Euler characteristic zero.

records.title: Segre–Harbourne–Gimigliano–Hirschowitz Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that a linear system of plane curves in P^2 with base points in general position is special if and only if its fixed locus contains a multiple (-1)-curve; equivalently, every Cremona-reduced such linear system is non-special.

records.title: Square Peg Problem (Toeplitz's Inscribed Square Conjecture)
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every continuous simple closed (Jordan) curve in the plane contains four points forming the vertices of a square.

records.title: Pisot Substitution Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every irreducible unimodular Pisot substitution dynamical system has pure discrete spectrum.

records.title: Polynomial-Time Quasioptimal Logarithmic-Energy Points on the 2-Sphere
records.exactTarget: Give a uniform real-number algorithm that, for every N >= 2, constructs N points on S^2 in time polynomial in N with logarithmic energy at most the minimum possible energy plus c log N for an absolute constant c.

records.title: Liouville problem for stationary Navier–Stokes D-solutions in R^3
records.exactTarget: Must every smooth real solution (u,p) of -Delta u+(u dot grad)u+grad p=0 and div u=0 on R^3, with integral_R^3 |grad u|^2 dx finite and u(x) tending uniformly to zero as |x| tends to infinity, satisfy u identically zero?

records.title: Zilber's Quasiminimality Conjecture for the Complex Exponential Field
records.exactTarget: Prove that the complex exponential field C_exp = (C; +, *, exp) is quasiminimal: every subset of C definable (with parameters) in the expansion of the complex field by the complex exponential function is either countable or co-countable.

records.title: Persistence Conjecture for Weakly Reversible Mass-Action Systems
records.exactTarget: For every weakly reversible chemical reaction network with mass-action kinetics, prove that every positive trajectory whose stoichiometric compatibility class is bounded is persistent: no species concentration tends to zero along the omega-limit set; or construct a counterexample within that class.

records.title: Second Hardy-Littlewood Conjecture on Prime-Counting Subadditivity
records.witness: one pair (x,y) with pi(x+y) > pi(x)+pi(y)
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that pi(x+y) <= pi(x)+pi(y) for all integers x,y >= 2, where pi is the prime-counting function.

records.title: Gyarfas-Sumner Conjecture
records.exactTarget: For every tree T, prove that the class of finite graphs containing no induced subgraph isomorphic to T is chi-bounded; equivalently, find f_T with chi(G)<=f_T(omega(G)) for every induced-T-free graph G.

records.title: Weiss's Hyperfiniteness Question for Countable Amenable Group Actions
records.exactTarget: Determine whether the orbit equivalence relation of every Borel action of a countable amenable group is hyperfinite.

records.title: Furstenberg No-Bigeodesics (Planar FPP, Standard Minimum Moment)
records.exactTarget: For every non-atomic probability law G on [0,infinity) such that E[min(t_1,t_2,t_3,t_4)^2]<infinity for four independent G-distributed variables, assign independent G-distributed passage times t_e to the unoriented nearest-neighbor edges of Z^2. Is it almost surely the case that there is no doubly infinite self-avoiding nearest-neighbor path (v_i)_{i in Z} for which, for every i<j, the segment from v_i to v_j minimizes the sum of edge passage times over all finite nearest-neighbor paths with those endpoints? The probability is for the product edge law. This is the standard minimum-moment version selected from the legacy canonical finite-moment scope using Damron–Hanson A1' and Ahlberg–Hoffman A1, not a claim of equivalence to Damron–Hanson's separately stated moment-free conjecture. No first moment of a single edge, exponential moment, absolute continuity of a density, curvature assumption, or deterministic asymptotic direction is imposed.

records.title: Caratheodory Two-Umbilic Conjecture
records.exactTarget: Prove that every closed convex C^2 surface in Euclidean three-space has at least two umbilic points.

records.title: Voronoi Conjecture on Parallelohedra
records.witness: one parallelohedron that is not affinely Voronoi
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every parallelohedron (a convex polytope that tiles R^d by translations) is an affine image of the Dirichlet-Voronoi polytope of some lattice.

records.title: Infinitude of Fermat Primes
records.exactTarget: Determine whether infinitely many Fermat numbers F_n=2^(2^n)+1 are prime; equivalently, prove that the set of n≥0 with F_n prime is infinite or prove that it is finite.

records.title: List edge-coloring conjecture
records.witness: one multigraph with list index > chromatic index
records.exactTarget: Prove or disprove that every finite loopless multigraph G has list chromatic index equal to its ordinary chromatic index, that is, chi'_ell(G)=chi'(G).

records.title: Permanent Anti-Concentration and Robust Classical Hardness of BosonSampling
records.exactTarget: Prove the Permanent Anti-Concentration Conjecture: there exists a polynomial p, positive on the indicated arguments, such that for every positive integer n and every delta > 0, Pr[|Per(X)| < sqrt(n!)/p(n,1/delta)] < delta, where X is an n x n matrix of independent standard complex Gaussian entries (independent real and imaginary parts, each N(0,1/2), with 1/2 denoting variance).

records.title: Potential Density of Rational Points on K3 Surfaces
records.exactTarget: For every number field K and every K3 surface X/K (smooth, projective and geometrically integral, with trivial canonical bundle and H^1(X,O_X)=0), there exists a finite extension L/K for which X(L) is Zariski dense in X.

records.title: Positive Counting Rule for Type-A Schubert Structure Constants
records.witness: a positive counting rule for Schubert structure constants
records.exactTarget: For the ordinary type-A Schubert-polynomial structure constants c^w_(u,v), defined by S_u S_v = sum_w c^w_(u,v) S_w for finite permutations, does there exist one uniform positive counting rule in the #P sense: a polynomial p and deterministic polynomial-time predicate R such that c^w_(u,v) equals the number of bit strings y of length p(|x|) with R(x,y)=1, for every explicitly one-line-encoded triple x=(u,v,w)?

records.title: Bounded Negativity Conjecture for Complex Projective Surfaces
records.exactTarget: For every smooth complex projective surface X, prove that there is a constant b(X) such that C^2 >= -b(X) for every reduced irreducible curve C on X.

records.title: Lehmer's Conjecture on the Nonvanishing of the Ramanujan Tau Function
records.witness: one n with tau(n)=0
records.exactTarget: Prove that Ramanujan's tau function never vanishes: tau(n) != 0 for every positive integer n, where tau(n) are the Fourier coefficients of the weight-12 cusp form Delta(z) = q prod_{k>=1} (1-q^k)^24.
